title: Skyline Gondola & Luge Queenstown
meta_desc: Honest family review of Skyline Gondola & Luge in Queenstown, NZ. Prices, age suitability, and tips for a fun day out with kids.
intro: The Skyline Gondola & Luge in Queenstown is a must-do activity for families. With panoramic views of Lake Wakatipu and a thrilling luge ride, it's an experience your kids will love. But what's it really like with kids, and is it value for money?

sections.heading: What to Expect
sections.body:
The Skyline Gondola & Luge is a 2-4 hour activity that's suitable for kids aged 3 and above. The gondola ride up Bob's Peak offers breathtaking views of Queenstown and Lake Wakatipu, and the luge ride down is a thrilling experience for kids and adults alike.

Kids can ride the luge solo from age 3, and our little ones loved the freedom of racing down the track. The restaurant at the top is also good value for lunch, with a range of kid-friendly options.

However, be prepared for some crowds and queues, especially during peak season. The gondola can also be a bit scary for younger kids, so be sure to prepare them in advance.

sections.heading: Value for Money
sections.body:
At $50 per adult and $35 per child, the Skyline Gondola & Luge is a bit pricey, but we think it's worth it for the unique experience and stunning views.

However, if you're on a tight budget, consider visiting during the off-season or looking for package deals that include other activities.

sections.heading: Insider Tips
sections.body:
To make the most of your visit, try to avoid peak season (December to February) and opt for a morning or late afternoon visit to avoid the crowds.

Also, be sure to book in advance to secure your spot, especially during peak season.
list: Book in advance to avoid queues
Visit during off-peak season for better prices
Pack a lunch or snacks to save money

sections.heading: Booking and Savings
sections.body:
You can book the Skyline Gondola & Luge online or at the ticket office. Look out for package deals and discounts, especially for families or groups.

Some tips for saving money include booking a combo deal with other activities, or looking for special promotions and discounts on the official website.
